lines.text: Earn PokéCoins and encounter Groudon in GO Pass: November!
The GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe for November will be available from November 3, 2026 at 10:00 am to December 1, 2026 at 10:00 am local time.
GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe

Trainers will automatically receive GO Pass: November on Tuesday, November 3, at 10:00 a.m. local time. You can collect GO Points and rank up to get additional rewards through Tuesday, December 1, at 10:00 a.m. local time.
Additionally, from Saturday, November 28, at 12:00 a.m. to Sunday, November 29, at 11:59 p.m. local time, there’s no daily limit for how many GO Points you can earn!
For US$7.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass that offers upgraded rewards and faster progression.
For US$9.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe + 10 Ranks to also automatically earn enough GO Points to reach Rank 11.

While progressing through the GO Pass Deluxe, you’ll be able to claim all of the rewards from both the free GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe. You can upgrade to a GO Pass Deluxe at any time and still collect rewards from previously unlocked ranks.
Rewards unlocked in the GO Pass will expire on Thursday, December 3, at 10:00 a.m. local time, so be sure to claim your rewards before they’re gone!
Complete Pass Tasks to rank up your GO Pass to earn the following rewards.
Trainers who upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe can also earn the following rewards.
1,000 additional PokéCoins for a total of 1,400 PokéCoins
Additional encounters with even more Pokémon!
Reach Major Milestones on your GO Pass to unlock the following bonuses.
One additional Candy for trading Pokémon
Trainers level 31 and above will receive one guaranteed Candy XL when trading Pokémon
Open up to 40 Gifts per day
Receive up to 125 Gifts per day from spinning PokéStop and Gym Photo Discs
Hold 10 more Gifts in your Item Bag
Increased XP and Stardust from hatching Eggs

Upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe to strengthen the following bonus:
Open up to 50 Gifts per day
Receive up to 150 Gifts per day from spinning PokéStop and Gym Photo Discs
Hold up to 20 more Gifts in your Item Bag
Earn points to increase your rank and unlock rewards. You can earn points by completing Pass Tasks. Any rewards you earn for completing a Pass Task will be awarded as soon as you finish the task.

The GO Pass Deluxe, the paid version of the GO Pass, will also be available on the Pokémon GO Web Store! Your GO Pass Deluxe purchased via the Pokémon GO Web Store will activate as soon as the GO Pass begins.
Trainers who upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: November on the Pokémon GO Web Store will receive 10 Ultra Balls, five Max Revives, one Premium Battle Pass, and five Max Potions as a gift with purchase.
Trainers who upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: November + 10 Ranks will receive 10 Ultra Balls, five Max Revives, two Premium Battle Passes, and five Max Potions as a gift with purchase.

Or stock up on the essentials alongside your upgrade with the web-exclusive GO Pass Deluxe: November Ultra Box which includes 20 Ultra Balls, 10 Max Revives, 10 Max Potions, and five Premium Battle Passes as a gift with purchase!

GO Pass: Dynamax Trails is a special GO Pass available during the Dynamax Trails: Eternatus Returns event , but released as early access during the Pokémon GO Wild Area 2026: Global event . It features encounters with Dynamax Pokémon, the return of Eternatus, and large amounts of Eternatus candy to farm. Available from November 16, 2026, 10:00 AM local time to November 23, 2026, 8:00 PM local time.

Trainers who claimed the Rank 1 rewards of the free track during GO Pass: Into the Wild 2026 received GO Pass: Dynamax Trails early on November 14th, 10:00 a.m. local time and were automatically upgraded to the Deluxe version for free.
GO Pass Dynamax Trails: Tasks and Rewards
Complete Pass Tasks to rank up and earn the following rewards. Ranks 101 through 300 award Eternatus Candy, Eternatus Candy XL, and Stardust.
